title: Eternal Covenant
paragraphs: “What!?”
When Father turned to Big Sister, she nodded. Seeing that reaction, it seems he believed her. It appears their Kizuna is already quite strong.
“Yes, it seems the people of Melromarc follow a religion called the Three Heroes Cult. The village where I lived practiced a different religion, though…”
“Religious rivals… So does that mean they’re on bad terms with the country that worships the Shield Hero?”

“That’s right. The Shield Hero is the hero worshiped by the Demi-Humans, while Siltvelt is the country where Father is worshiped. I don’t know much about Shieldfreeden, but apparently he’s an object of worship there as well.”
“Guh?”

Oh, Filo-chan… the way you tilt your little head like that is absolutely adorable! I’d love to record that voice on a sound-recording crystal and listen to it 24 hours a day, 365 days a year! When do you sleep? HAHAHA, I’d want to listen to it even while you’re sleeping.

Plus, in the future, your schedule was so busy you couldn’t even meet me, but it seems you’re not quite that busy right now. I’d really like to get along well with you, Filo-chan. But before that, I’ll have to get permission from Father. I’ll have to explain things thoroughly.

“You know the rest, don’t you? Those guys think they can do whatever they want to Father—the Shield Hero, who’s labeled a demon or a demon king for religious reasons—and Trash and Crimson Swine are trying to torment him.”
Father’s eyes widened in surprise. Then he started thinking things over for a bit.
“Persecuted for religious reasons… so? What are you asking of me?”
“I’d like you to take me in as an ally.”
“That’s not the point. I’m asking what you plan to do once you’re part of the group.”
“I’d like you to approve my engagement to Filo-tan.”
“What on earth are you talking about?!”
“Um… this conversation doesn’t make much sense. Is everything okay?”
“I’m not so sure. To be honest, I think this might be pretty bad. Maybe he just took a blow in the wrong spot or something.”
Father is keeping a wary eye on me while consulting with Big Sister. I guess he still doesn’t believe me.
“Well, it wasn’t my head that got hit—it was my groin… So, is that silly saying true—that a womanizer’s brain is in his groin…?”
Father is wearing a rather ambiguous expression. This isn’t looking good. At this rate, he might not trust me. Alright, how about I get Big Sister to help persuade him too?
“Big Sister”
“Eh… Based on the order in which we’ve been taking care of Naofumi-sama, does that mean I’m ‘Big Sister’ because I’m Filo’s Older Sister?”
“That’s right.”
As expected of Big Sister, you’re very perceptive. You are, after all, Filo-chan’s Older Sister.
“I see. So… what is it?”
“To gain your trust, I’ll share some information about the future.”
“Now it’s my turn, is it…?”
“What are you planning to say?”
“Well… we’ve looped back many times so far, but perhaps someone will appear who can be a source of emotional support for Father even if you aren’t around?”
“What on earth are you talking about!?”

Oh? That backfired, didn’t it? Big Sis’s guard is up now. I feel like Father from the first world is saying, “You’re still just as stupid as ever.” That’s not true! I’m not stupid! I’m just faithful to love!
“Naofumi-sama, I absolutely cannot trust you!”
“So I just missed the mark and ended up looking like an idiot after all…”
“Please wait! Please hear me out! I made a mistake!”
“We’ll see about that…”
Come on, R'yne! I’m experiencing an endorphin rush! Ha… Knowledge from a loop I experienced before raced through my mind, and a brilliant idea struck me.
“I know the names of the villagers where my older sister used to live, and I know she has an Older Sister!”
“Oh, really… Does Raphtalia have an Older Sister?”
Huh? Father seems interested. She’s here, she’s here. The Older Sister of that super-strong orca therianthrope’s Older Sister.
“An Older Sister?”
“Doesn’t she have one?”
“She must have one! She’s the Older Sister of that orca therianthrope who used Lightning Magic and worked as a fisherman in the neighborhood!”
“Hmm… Could you be referring to Sadeena? I’ve heard that her parents cherished her like a daughter, and to me, she was like a sister.”
“You could look that up later, couldn’t you? Like, after being rejected by Raphtalia, you just can’t let it go and decide to dig into her background.”

Guh… I suppose that’s not entirely out of the question. Then Father started whispering with my older sister. But with these enhanced ears—the Motoyasu Ears—I can pick up even the faintest whispers! Motoyasu Ears! Full Drive!
“What do you think?”
Alright, I can make out every word perfectly. This means I’m not left out of the loop anymore!
“It’s way too outlandish to be a lie… Motoyasu isn’t an idiot… no, normally he’d tell a much better lie, right?”
“Why did you stop halfway through?”
“If that wasn’t an act, then he’s just a complete idiot right now.”
“…You’re right.”
“Or rather, was it the future…? If he really could use such a powerful skill, it does make you wonder why he didn’t use it in the duel…”

Of course, there’s no way I could have used Brionac at that point. I knew from the game’s lore that I’d eventually be able to use it, though. It’s a shameful past—I foolishly turned my blade against Father, who had such low attack power, and ended up losing. On top of that, the Crimson Swine used underhanded tactics to tarnish the sacred duel. He’s gone now, but he was a filthy scum of a man—no matter how many times I killed him, it still wouldn’t have been enough.

Anyway, I turned over a new leaf and swore to fight for the peaceful world that Father and Filo are striving for. This oath is an eternal pact that will never falter—not even after the world achieves peace… or even if a new loop begins!
“W-well, if you have some sort of plan, that’s fine…”
“But you’re not planning to kill that woman or make Filo your bride, are you? You don’t seem to have any intention of convincing us.”
“It’s strange in so many ways, isn’t it? As for whether that story about you coming from the future is actually true… why don’t you test it out a little more?”
“Hmm… Well… I do have a slight hunch. What should I do…? It’s a revelation that the unreasonable things happening to me are actually caused by religion, but…”
You seem troubled. I suppose there’s nothing to be done about it.
“Then, as proof that I’m joining you, I’ll hand over my entire fortune.”

I reached into my pocket and handed Father a money pouch. I don’t know how much is in it, but it’s just pocket change anyway. Since I’m going to be handing over all my money to Father anyway, if this helps me gain even a little trust, it’s a win. Father took my money and his eyes widened even more.
“You’re just going to say it got stolen, aren’t you!”
“I won’t say that. If I did, Father and Filo would end up hating me. If you want, I’ll earn more and bring it back.”
If I can build trust with money, so be it. Here we go—the tribute! Tribute, tribute—a mountain of gold coins!

At my words, Father fell silent and began checking the contents of the money bag. Given that it’s been a few days since the first wave ended, there should be a decent amount in there. Well, I figure I could easily earn this much by wiping out griffins in the mountains or hunting down bandits. I’ll work like a workhorse to contribute to you, Father! The fact that the “workhorse” analogy shares a common spirit with Lady Filolial is quite appealing.
“So, Father. What should we do next?”
